IncidentContext.notes: Deliberately contains NO free-text fields, no operator identifiers, no filenames or paths of uploads, and no image data (Phase 6 sections 7-8).

detector_score.description: Detector score. NOT a calibrated probability; must never be rendered as a probability of hostility, identity or intent.

posture_rule.description: Identifier of the deterministic ai_safety rule that produced the posture.

event_id.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical event record; never a filename or path.

IncidentSummary.notes: Free-form recommendation text is intentionally absent. The forbidden-claim linter (Phase 6 section 9.3) runs on headline/facts/uncertainties before rendering; any hit discards the whole output.

field_ref.description: JSON pointer into the IncidentContext this fact is derived from. The validator checks every numeral and class name in 'statement' against the referenced value.

limitations.const: A model classification is not a confirmation of identity, intent or hostility.

status: DESIGN SPECIFICATION — Phase 6. No LLM is implemented, no runner consumes this file yet. It defines the only shapes a future, owner-approved LLM layer may use (docs/LLM_PROMPT_AUDIT_PHASE6.md sections 8-9).
